name: Double-Sided Aces
detailed_description:
Double-sided Aces is a text-based adventure game blending suspenseful puzzles with multi-route romance.

You will play as Yang Zaize, an undercover police officer investigating the cutting-edge chip company [Kuin Science], only to find yourself entangled in a complex conspiracy between law and crime. Through interactions with six characters of diverse personalities and intricate backgrounds, your dialogue and action choices will shape branching storylines, leading to multiple endings.

Every decision determines Yang Zaize’s fate. Will he uphold justice or succumb to darkness? The answer lies in your hands.

Two Cities, Two Syndicates

[Kuin Science] is renowned for its chip design and biotechnology, pioneering implantable chip innovations. However, authorities suspect deep-rooted collusion between this corporation and the [Du Group] — a violent organization entrenched in real estate, gambling, and mining. The syndicate’s leader remains shrouded in mystery, and the identity of their heir is concealed behind layers of deception.

 

Dual Identities

A spectral detective who appears frequently, a enigmatic doctor met at a bar, a genius hacker who is also your stepbrother, a spirit medium bridging the living and the dead, an ambiguous superior, and a childhood friend with hidden ties…

Each character wears two masks — are you touching the truth, or meticulously woven lies?

 

Dual Worlds

As the story unfolds, the appearance of a "ghost" unveils secrets spanning the realms of the living and the dead, intertwining Yang Zaize’s destiny with past-life entanglements. The boundary between reality and reincarnation blurs, forcing Yang Zaize to navigate technological conspiracies, gang warfare, and karmic cycles in a deadly game that transcends life and death.

In Double-sided Aces, players take on the role of a character, navigating choices and interactions to win the hearts of six distinct and captivating characters, embarking on a thrilling adventure.

Yang Zaize (28 years old / Undercover Agent):

A charming yet weary police officer infiltrating [Kuin Science] to expose its illicit dealings with the [Du Group] through implantable chip investigations.

 

Zhu Feng (26 years old / Ghost):

A spectral figure tied to Zaize’s past, aiding him in unraveling mysteries.

Yue Liang (30 years old / Doctor):

A bar regular with unparalleled medical expertise and shadowy ties to the syndicate.

Yang Xun (22 years old / Student):

Zaize’s stepbrother with top-tier hacking skills, secretly supporting his mission.

Xinyou (28 years old / Childhood Friend):

Runs an arcade, but his true connection to the syndicate slowly surfaces.

Yu Hao (29 years old / Superior):

Zaize’s enigmatic corporate superior, balancing rivalry and unspoken camaraderie.

Shu Minzhi (26 years old / Spirit Medium):

Reads souls through their colors, drawn into the chip conspiracy while investigating haunted sites.

The developer specifies the game includes:Criminal acts; derogatory language; depictions of severe pain, bloodshed, violence, accidental death, bodily harm, corpses, nudity and alcohol consumption.

short_description: This is a BL Dating Sim featuring multiple male protagonists. Six unique love interests, all fully voice-acted! Make choices at every step to uncover their hidden double lives. Zaize Yang, works at a tech company and gets caught up in a web of gangs and betrayal. What choices will he make?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 2.0 Ghz 64-bit Intel-compatible
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 compatible video card (integrated or dedicated with min 512MB memory)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
